messages:
lin: quick sync — i'm drafting a new telemetry surface for the console: we need to expose counts for fallbacks/degraded-mode, runtime OOMs, server 5xx, and quota rejects. looking for input on metric names, labels, and rollout UX.

maya: +1. main questions: cardinality (routes/customers), attribution (model vs route), and alerting semantics.

samir: split concerns: (1) realtime safety signals for oncall (high-res, aggregated), (2) long-term trends for product/console (lower-res, richer labels). avoid free-form route label. use route_id or hashed_route to control cardinality.

lin: agree. proposal: emit these base metrics from runtime as counters: runtime.fallback_total, runtime.degraded_enter_total, runtime.oom_total, runtime.5xx_total, runtime.quota_reject_total. each has labels: route_id, model_variant, region, reason (where reason is limited enum).

jordan: for console panels we need two views: global health (p50/p95 latency, error rates, fallback rate) and per-route rollup (top 10 by traffic and top 10 by fallback% ). rollout UX expects canary->gradual->global, so dashboards must support comparing canary vs baseline.

nina: +privacy note: customer_id cannot appear on public dashboards. for billing/alerts store customer_id in a separate telemetry path with access controls. console can show customer_tier or anonymized bucket.

maya: cardinality mitigation ideas:
- hash route to 32-bit route_id (static mapping)
- limit model_variant label to known set (quantized variants)
- reason dimension should be small: {timeout, oom, kernel, rate_limit, fallback_policy}

samir: ops needs a high-res alerting-friendly metric. recommend a 1m scrape for the alert rule:
```
sum by(route_id) (increase(runtime.fallback_total[5m])) / sum by(route_id) (increase(requests_total[5m]))
```
alert when > 0.01 for 15m (configurable). also alert on sudden spike in oom_total.

lin: can we get a short PromQL snippet for degraded-mode counting? i want to include in the dashboard PR.

maya: use this for degraded sessions (counts of enter events):
```
sum by(route_id, model_variant) (increase(runtime.degraded_enter_total[5m]))
```
and percentage over requests:
```
100 * sum by(route_id) (increase(runtime.degraded_enter_total[5m])) / sum by(route_id) (increase(requests_total[5m]))
```

samir: watch out for double-counting when fallback happens multiple times per request. runtime should emit only one fallback_enter per request lifecycle.

lin: runtime action: ensure single emit per request, add reason enum, add route_id label. product & console action: dashboard templates that can toggle by model_variant and region. sres: alerting rules plus runbook link.

jordan: UI ask: allow overlay of canary vs baseline on same chart and an annotation layer for rollout change events. also provide quick filters for model_variant & reason.

nina: retention/volume question — how long do we keep per-route broken-down metrics? storing full breakdown at 30d will be expensive. propose: detailed rollups (per-route_id, per-model_variant) for 7d, aggregated (global/model) for 90d.

samir: +1. also add sampled traces link (trace_id label) on high fallback spikes for debugging. runtime should attach a small sample_id to emitted fallback events to allow trace correlation.

deploy-bot: canary deployed telemetry-proto v0.3 to staging at 1873456900 :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: incident note: last night we saw a 2x bump in degraded_mode % for eu-west; it correlated with a model_variant rollout. saving that as precedent for alert sensitivity tuning.

lin: next steps/action items (short):
- lin/maya: finalize metric names + proto fields by EOD Thu
- samir: draft alert rules + runbook by Mon
- jordan: mockup dashboard panels & canary overlay by Tue
- nina: estimate storage cost for 7d detailed / 90d aggregate
- eng-runtime: implement single-emit fallback + reason enum in v0.3

maya: minor note: in logs we still need to keep the original error message for debugging, but that should not be a label on metrics. link via sampled trace.

lin: thanks — i'll open a PR with the proto + sample PromQL & panel JSONs once we lock names. ping me if you want to be in the review. :thumbsup:
